frontmatter.name: concise
frontmatter.description: Cuts prose filler from agent responses - trailing summaries, restated context, hedging, over-long preambles, oversized code comments - while leaving code logic, analysis depth, and correctness fully intact. Use when the user says "be concise", "concise mode", "cut the fluff", "stop summarizing", "less filler", or asks for shorter responses. Works on any Agent Skills compatible tool (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex, Gemini CLI, and others) - installed via
